# Trivy IaC exemptions for the shared security workflow (security / iac).
# id | path | expires (YYYY-MM-DD) | issue | reason
#
# Why these rows: the check was turned on with the High and Critical
# findings then on main baselined here (#902). The fixable ones are fixed.
# Each row left is either on purpose (a later expiry date) or needs a
# change to running customer stacks that cannot ship as a preset default,
# and names the follow-up issue that tracks it. Presets apply into customer
# accounts on every compose, so a fix that replaces a resource or changes
# its network or access behaviour on the next apply is planned, not baselined
# silently.
AWS-0053 | aws/alb/main.tf | 2027-11-17 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#910 | on purpose: the preset is the stack's public entry point, so the ALB is internet-facing by default; a composed stack reached only through a VPN or peering opts in with the composer field aws_alb.internal, which the composer refuses with aws_cloudfront in the stack
AWS-0054 | aws/alb/main.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#910 | on purpose: with no certificate_arn there is no certificate for TLS, so HTTP forwards; with one, HTTP redirects to HTTPS
AWS-0132 | aws/alb/main.tf | 2027-10-31 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#909 | on purpose: ELB delivers ALB access logs only to SSE-S3 buckets; a customer-managed KMS key would stop log delivery
AWS-0132 | aws/s3/main.tf | 2027-11-17 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#909 | SSE-S3 stays the default: SSE-KMS needs kms:Decrypt for every reader of a live bucket; a composed stack opts in with composer field aws_s3.kmsKeyArn (kms_key_arn), which also grants kms:Decrypt to the aws/bedrock and aws/kendra readers it wires; other readers need the caller's grant
AWS-0132 | aws/sagemaker/main.tf | 2027-11-17 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#909 | SSE-S3 stays the default on live workspace buckets; a composed stack opts in with composer field aws_sagemaker.workspaceKmsKeyArn (workspace_kms_key_arn), which also grants the execution role kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey
AWS-0104 | aws/alb/main.tf | 2027-11-17 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | on purpose: open egress stays the default (IP targets outside the VPC, authenticate-oidc on live stacks); a composed stack narrows it by opting in with composer field aws_alb.egressCidrs (egress_cidrs)
AWS-0104 | aws/rds/main.tf | 2027-11-17 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | on purpose: open egress stays the default, because live databases may use extensions that call out (aws_s3, aws_lambda, dblink); a composed stack narrows it by opting in with composer field aws_rds.egressCidrs (egress_cidrs)
AWS-0104 | aws/elasticache/main.tf | 2027-11-17 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | on purpose: open egress stays the default on live stacks; a composed stack narrows it by opting in with composer field aws_elasticache.egressCidrs (egress_cidrs)
AWS-0104 | aws/msk/main.tf | 2027-11-17 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | on purpose: open egress stays the default on live stacks; a composed stack narrows it (the rule then also admits self) by opting in with composer field aws_msk.egressCidrs (egress_cidrs)
AWS-0104 | aws/bastion/main.tf | 2027-11-17 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | on purpose: needs internet egress for SSM Session Manager, dnf and the EKS tools in user_data; no VPC endpoints exist to narrow it to
AWS-0104 | aws/ec2/main.tf | 2027-11-17 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | on purpose: general-purpose instance: the app's outbound traffic is unknown to the preset, and no VPC endpoints exist to narrow it to
AWS-0104 | aws/lambda/main.tf | 2027-11-17 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#907 | on purpose: default SG of a VPC function, which reaches AWS APIs and third parties through NAT; no VPC endpoints exist to narrow it to
AWS-0107 | aws/bastion/main.tf | 2027-11-17 | luthersystems/insideout-terraform-presets#908 | admin_cidrs stays 0.0.0.0/0 by default: removing it locks out key-pair and EC2 Instance Connect users on live bastions; a composed stack opts in with composer field aws_bastion.adminCidrs (an empty list for SSM only, or the admin networks)
